description: A Lockhart wavefolder: the signal is folded back on itself by a model of a diode circuit

params.text: Sets how hard the signal is driven into the folder, 0 to 1
Shifts the signal before it is folded, -5V to 5V, which moves the folds off centre and brings in even harmonics
Sets the level of the folded signal, 0 to 1
Sets the resistance in the modelled circuit, 10000 to 100000 ohms, which changes the shape of each fold
Sets the load resistance in the modelled circuit, 1000 to 10000 ohms, which sets how much of the folded signal is fed back
Attenuates the voltage at the In-Gain jack before it is added to the In-Gain knob, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the Offset jack before it is added to the Offset knob, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the Out-Gain jack before it is added to the Out-Gain knob, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the Resistor jack before it is added to the Resistor knob, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the Load Resistor jack before it is added to the Load Resistor knob, 0 to 1

inputs.text: The signal to be folded, one per channel
Modulates the drive, a tenth per volt scaled by the Input gain CV knob
Modulates the shift, one volt per volt scaled by the Offset CV knob
Modulates the resistance, 5000 ohms per volt scaled by the Resistor CV knob
Modulates the load resistance, 500 ohms per volt scaled by the Load resistor CV knob
Modulates the output level, a tenth per volt scaled by the Output gain CV knob

outputs.text: The folded signal, rounded off at the ends of its travel and with its constant offset removed

notes: the folding is worked out from the two resistances, so those two knobs change the character of the folds rather than their number, which comes from In-Gain

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
